pairs.target: lín zhào bǎshǒu shēnjìn mádài dǐxià , mō dào yípiàn liáng shī .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao slipped her hand into the space beneath a burlap sack and felt a patch of cool dampness.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把手伸进麻袋底下，摸到一片凉湿。

pairs.target: zuóyè luò guò yǔ , huò péng de yánkǒu hái zài dīshuǐ .
pairs.english: Rain had fallen last night, and water was still dripping from the freight shed's eaves.
pairs.hanzi: 昨夜落过雨，货棚的檐口还在滴水。

pairs.target: tā dūnxiàqù , jiāng dàizǐ fān le bànmiàn , dǐxià de cǎoxí yǐjīng yīn hēi le , biānjiǎo tiēzhe dì , jiē qǐlái shí dài chū yìgǔ mēn suān qì .
pairs.english: She crouched down and turned the sack halfway over; the mat underneath had already darkened with moisture, its corners clinging to the ground, and lifting it released a whiff of musty sourness.
pairs.hanzi: 她蹲下去，将袋子翻了半面，底下的草席已经洇黑了，边角贴着地，揭起来时带出一股闷酸气。

pairs.target: shàngcéng de gān bǐng dǎo hái yìngshí , gé zhe yóuzhǐ niēyiniē , néng tīngjiàn xìsuì de liè shēng .
pairs.english: The flatbread in the upper layer was still firm, though; squeeze through the oiled paper and you could hear a faint crackle.
pairs.hanzi: 上层的干饼倒还硬实，隔着油纸捏一捏，能听见细碎的裂声。

pairs.target: tā chōudiào cǎoxí , zhǎo le liǎnggēn diànmù , yòu bǎ gānliáng nuó dào kào lǐ de jiàzi shàng .
pairs.english: She pulled out the mat, found two wooden supports, and shifted the provisions onto a shelf farther inside.
pairs.hanzi: 她抽掉草席，找了两根垫木，又把干粮挪到靠里的架子上。

pairs.target: pángbiān nà fù bèi jià yě dé zhòngzhuāng : tóngguō yā zài zuǒcè , liǎngzhī zhuāng dēngyóu de táo hú què dōu sāi zài yòubiān , zǒu píng lù háihǎo , yí shàng shíjiē , shéngzi jiù huì wǎng guō yán shàng mó .
pairs.english: The frame beside it needed repacking too: a copper pot weighed down the left side, but both earthenware flasks holding lamp oil had been wedged on the right; walking on level ground was fine, yet once they took to stone steps, the rope would start rubbing against the rim.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边那副背架也得重装：铜锅压在左侧，两只装灯油的陶壶却都塞在右边，走平路还好，一上石阶，绳子就会往锅沿上磨。

pairs.target: shào píng zài péngwài hǎn rén bān shuǐ .
pairs.english: Outside the shed, Shao Ping was calling for someone to carry water.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平在棚外喊人搬水。

pairs.target: lín zhào táitóu kàn le yìyǎn , jiāngyào jiào tā de nàjùhuà yàn huíqù , xiān jiěkāi le shéngkòu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao raised her head for a glance, swallowed the words she was about to call out to him, and undid the rope fastening first.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抬头看了一眼，将要叫他的那句话咽回去，先解开了绳扣。

pairs.target: děng tā tí zhe kōngtǒng huílái , tā yǐjīng bǎ liǎngzhī bèi jià bǎiqí , zhèng yòng xīgài dǐngzhù héngmù shōu shéng .
pairs.english: By the time he returned carrying the empty bucket, she had already lined up the two frames and was bracing the crossbar with her knee to tighten the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 等他提着空桶回来，她已经把两只背架摆齐，正用膝盖顶住横木收绳。

pairs.target: " guō ne ? "
pairs.english: “Where's the pot?”
pairs.hanzi: “锅呢？”

pairs.target: " xià tóu . "
pairs.english: “Underneath.”
pairs.hanzi: “下头。”

pairs.target: " yóu ne ? "
pairs.english: “And the oil?”
pairs.hanzi: “油呢？”

pairs.target: " fēnkāi le , yìbiān yì hú . "
pairs.english: “Separated now, one flask on either side.”
pairs.hanzi: “分开了，一边一壶。”

pairs.target: shào píng fàngxià tǒng , shēnshǒu mō guò bēidài , yòu rào dào lìngyícè .
pairs.english: Shao Ping set down the bucket, reached out to feel along the straps, then went around to the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平放下桶，伸手摸过背带，又绕到另一侧。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè shuōhuà , lín zhào biàn bǎ zuìhòu yídào shéngkòu yě lèjǐn le .
pairs.english: He did not speak immediately, so Lin Zhao tightened the last rope fastening as well.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有立刻说话，林照便把最后一道绳扣也勒紧了。

pairs.target: " zhè fù shì wǒ bèi de . "
pairs.english: “This frame is mine to carry.”
pairs.hanzi: “这副是我背的。”

pairs.target: tā zhōngyú shuō .
pairs.english: He finally spoke.
pairs.hanzi: 他终于说。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào .
pairs.english: “I know.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。

pairs.target: nǐ zuǒ jiān búshì téng me ? "
pairs.english: Isn't your left shoulder hurting, then?”
pairs.hanzi: 你左肩不是疼么？”

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ wǒ bǎ zhòng de fàng yòubiān . "
pairs.english: “That's why I put the heavy things on the right.”
pairs.hanzi: “所以我把重的放右边。”

pairs.target: lín zhào shǒushàng yídùn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao's hands went still.
pairs.hanzi: 林照手上一顿。

pairs.target: shào píng līn qǐ bèi jià , shìleshì , fàng huí dìshàng .
pairs.english: Shao Ping lifted the frame, tested its weight, and put it back on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平拎起背架，试了试，放回地上。

pairs.target: yóuhú zài lǐmiàn qīngqīng pèng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: The oil flasks inside made a soft clink.
pairs.hanzi: 油壶在里面轻轻碰了一声。

pairs.target: " zhè liǎngjiàn tiēzhe , gé bù ne ? "
pairs.english: “These two are touching; where's the padding?”
pairs.hanzi: “这两件贴着，隔布呢？”

pairs.target: " yuánlái nà kuài shī le .
pairs.english: “The old piece got wet.
pairs.hanzi: “原来那块湿了。

pairs.target: wǒ qù ná gān de . "
pairs.english: I will fetch a dry one.”
pairs.hanzi: 我去拿干的。”

pairs.target: " xiān bié ná .
pairs.english: “Don't fetch it yet.
pairs.hanzi: “先别拿。

pairs.target: nǐ gǎi le shénme , gēn wǒ shuō yìshēng , wǒ hǎo yídào chá . "
pairs.english: Tell me what you changed, so we can check it together.”
pairs.hanzi: 你改了什么，跟我说一声，我好一道查。”

pairs.target: lín zhàozhàn qǐlái , kù xī shàng zhān zhe liǎngdào huī .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao stood up, with two streaks of dust on her trouser knees.
pairs.hanzi: 林照站起来，裤膝上沾着两道灰。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng shuō , búguò huàn jǐgè wèizhì , nǎ yòngdézhe jiàn jiàn dōu bào , huàdàozuǐbiān , piējiàn jià jiǎo nà zhāng yǐjīng gōu mǎn de huòdān , yòu méi shuō chūlái .
pairs.english: She had meant to say that she had only changed a few positions—surely every single one didn't need reporting—but with the words on her lips, she spotted the fully checked-off manifest at the frame's foot, and said nothing after all.
pairs.hanzi: 她本想说，不过换几个位置，哪用得着件件都报，话到嘴边，瞥见架脚那张已经勾满的货单，又没说出来。

pairs.target: shào píng shùnzhe tā de mùguāng kàn guòqù , ná zhǐtou tán le tán zhǐ .
pairs.english: Following her gaze, Shao Ping looked over and flicked the paper with a finger.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平顺着她的目光看过去，拿指头弹了弹纸。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhào zhè zhāng zhǎo , nǐ zhào nǐ de bǎi , jìn le lǐtou , yào yòng dōngxī de shíhòu tīng shuí de ? "
pairs.english: “I use this list to find things, you arrange them your way; once we're inside and need supplies, whose instructions do we follow?”
pairs.hanzi: “我照这张找，你照你的摆，进了里头，要用东西的时候听谁的？”

pairs.target: péngwài yǒurén cuī : " lǎo shào , shuǐ hái zhuāng bu zhuāng ? "
pairs.english: Someone outside the shed called impatiently, “Shao, are we filling the water skins or not?”
pairs.hanzi: 棚外有人催：“老邵，水还装不装？”

pairs.target: " zhuāng !
pairs.english: “Yes!

pairs.target: tǒng yòu méi cháng tuǐ , nǐ xiān tí yítàng ! "
pairs.english: The bucket hasn't grown legs; you take a load first!”
pairs.hanzi: 桶又没长腿，你先提一趟！”

pairs.target: tā dá wán , huítóu bǎ shéngkòu sōng le .
pairs.english: After answering, he turned back and loosened the rope fastening.
pairs.hanzi: 他答完，回头把绳扣松了。

pairs.target: lín zhào qùqǔ gānbù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao went to fetch dry cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 林照去取干布。

pairs.target: huílái shí , tā jiāng shī cǎoxí zhǐ gěi tā kàn , yòu shuō le guō yán mó shéng de shì .
pairs.english: When she returned, she pointed out the damp mat for him to see, then explained about the pot rim chafing the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 回来时，她将湿草席指给他看，又说了锅沿磨绳的事。

pairs.target: zhèhuí shào píng dūnxiàqù , ná shǒuzhǐ yánzhe nà dào tóng biān mō le yìquān .
pairs.english: This time Shao Ping crouched down and felt all the way around that copper edge with his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 这回邵平蹲下去，拿手指沿着那道铜边摸了一圈。

pairs.target: " zhèlǐ bāo shàng .
pairs.english: “Wrap this part.
pairs.hanzi: “这里包上。

pairs.target: yóuhú wǎngshàngtí , yòubiān liú zhòng xiē . "
pairs.english: Move the oil flasks up, and leave the right side a little heavier.”
pairs.hanzi: 油壶往上提，右边留重些。”

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén chóngxīn zhuāng hǎo , shì bèi le yìhuí .
pairs.english: The two of them packed everything afresh and tried carrying it once.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人重新装好，试背了一回。

pairs.target: shào píng zài pénglǐ zǒu le jǐbù , jiān yì chén yì tái , hūrán wèn tā : " lián wǒ de yě tì wǒ bèi ? "
pairs.english: Shao Ping walked a few steps inside the shed, dipping and lifting his shoulder, then suddenly asked her, “Will you carry my load for me too?”
pairs.hanzi: 邵平在棚里走了几步，肩一沉一抬，忽然问她：“连我的也替我背？”

pairs.target: " nà nǐ bǎ gōngqián gěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Then give me your wages.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你把工钱给我。”

pairs.target: " dǎo xiǎng dé hǎo . "
pairs.english: “You wish.”
pairs.hanzi: “倒想得好。”

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ gǎiguò de dōngxī jì zài huòdān biānshàng , zì jǐ dé xìxiǎo .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao recorded the changed items along the manifest's margin, squeezing the characters very small.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把改过的东西记在货单边上，字挤得细小。

pairs.target: xiě dào zuìhòu , shào píng dì lái nà zhī kōngtǒng , tā kàn le kàn tā , tā biàn cháo péngwài tái xiàbā .
pairs.english: Finishing her notes, she found Shao Ping handing over the empty bucket; she glanced at him, and he tipped his chin toward the shed entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 写到最后，邵平递来那只空桶，她看了看他，他便朝棚外抬下巴。

pairs.target: " xiànzài kěyǐ zhuāng shuǐ le . "
pairs.english: “Now you can fill the water skins.”
pairs.hanzi: “现在可以装水了。”

pairs.target: děng shuǐnáng dōu guà hǎo , rìtou yǐjīng shài dào le péng kǒu .
pairs.english: By the time all the water skins were hung up, sunlight had already reached the shed entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 等水囊都挂好，日头已经晒到了棚口。

pairs.target: lín zhào xǐdiào shǒushàng de yóuhuī , qù qiánwū zhǎo guǎnshì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao washed the oily grime off her hands and went to the front room to find the steward.
pairs.hanzi: 林照洗掉手上的油灰，去前屋找管事。

pairs.target: fāng jǐn zuòzài chuāng xià , zhàngcè páng fàng zhe yìzhī kòu yán de pí xiá .
pairs.english: Fang Jin sat beneath the window; beside the ledger lay a leather case with its clasp fastened tight.
pairs.hanzi: 方谨坐在窗下，账册旁放着一只扣严的皮匣。

pairs.target: tā xiān kàn huòdān , zài kàn tā , mùguāng zài zhǐbiān nà liè xiǎozì shàng tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: He looked at the manifest first, then at her, his gaze pausing briefly on the column of small characters along the paper's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 他先看货单，再看她，目光在纸边那列小字上停了一下。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiě de ? "
pairs.english: “You wrote this?”
pairs.hanzi: “你写的？”

pairs.target: " ǹg .
pairs.english: “Yes.

pairs.target: yǒu jǐyàng huàn le wèizhì , shào shū chá guò . "
pairs.english: A few things have changed places; Uncle Shao checked them.”
pairs.hanzi: 有几样换了位置，邵叔查过。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng huòdān yā zài zhàngcè dǐxià , lìng qǔ yìzhāng qìzhǐ , zhuǎnxiàng tā .
pairs.english: He slipped the manifest under the ledger, took out another contract sheet, and turned it toward her.
pairs.hanzi: 他将货单压在账册底下，另取一张契纸，转向她。

pairs.target: " qù chéng , rù kū , fǎnchéng , gèduàn de gōngqián dōu zài zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: “The wages for each stage—the outward journey, entering the dungeon, and the return—are all here.
pairs.hanzi: “去程、入窟、返程，各段的工钱都在这里。

pairs.target: qīng kū huílái , lìngwài yǒu yífèn chéngshì qián .
pairs.english: Return after clearing the dungeon, and there's an additional completion bonus.
pairs.hanzi: 清窟回来，另外有一份成事钱。

pairs.target: lùshang tīng lǐngduì ānpái , bùdé sī qǔ dōngxī . "
pairs.english: Obey the leader's arrangements on the journey; do not privately take any objects.”
pairs.hanzi: 路上听领队安排，不得私取东西。”

pairs.target: lín zhào shùnzhe tā zhǐ de dìfāng kàn , kàndào chéngshì qián , xīnlǐ xiān suànle yíbiàn , shǒuzhǐ què tíng zài xiàmiàn yìháng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked at the spot he indicated; when she saw the completion bonus, she first calculated it mentally, but her finger stopped on the line below.
pairs.hanzi: 林照顺着他指的地方看，看到成事钱，心里先算了一遍，手指却停在下面一行。

pairs.target: " zhège jiàn bǎo , huílái jiù gěi me ? "
pairs.english: “This reference—do I get it as soon as we're back?”
pairs.hanzi: “这个荐保，回来就给么？”

pairs.target: " lǐngduì qiān rèn nǐ zuò wán fènnèi de shì , wǒ cáinéng chū . "
pairs.english: “I can only issue it once the leader signs to confirm that you finished the work required of you.”
pairs.hanzi: “领队签认你做完分内的事，我才能出。”

pairs.target: " yǒu le zhège , jiù néng qù lǐng zìjǐ de xíng pái ? "
pairs.english: “With that, can I go and collect a porter license of my own?”
pairs.hanzi: “有了这个，就能去领自己的行牌？”

pairs.target: fāng jǐn bǎ yuánběn yào dìgěi tā de bǐ gē huí bǐ shān .
pairs.english: Fang Jin returned the brush he had intended to hand her to its rest.
pairs.hanzi: 方谨把原本要递给她的笔搁回笔山。

pairs.target: " háiyào héyàn .
pairs.english: “Verification is required as well.
pairs.hanzi: “还要核验。

pairs.target: búshì yìfēng jiàn shū huàn yíkuài pái . "
pairs.english: A letter of recommendation doesn't simply buy a license.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是一封荐书换一块牌。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào háiyào héyàn .
pairs.english: “I know verification is required as well.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道还要核验。

pairs.target: wǒ wèn de shì , zhè yítàng suànbusuàn . "
pairs.english: My question is: for this expedition, does it count?”
pairs.hanzi: 我问的是，这一趟算不算。”

pairs.target: tā chóngxīn kàn le tā yìyǎn .
pairs.english: He gave her another glance.
pairs.hanzi: 他重新看了她一眼。

pairs.target: " suàn . "
pairs.english: “It does.”

pairs.target: lín zhào zhè cái jiē bǐ .
pairs.english: Only then did Lin Zhao take the brush.
pairs.hanzi: 林照这才接笔。

pairs.target: qìzhǐ shàng yǐjīng xiě hǎo le tā de míngzì , tā yòu zài xiàmiàn qiān le yíbiàn , mòbǐ shōu dé yǒuxiē zhòng .
pairs.english: Her name had been written on the contract already; she signed beneath it once more, finishing with a slightly heavy final stroke.
pairs.hanzi: 契纸上已经写好了她的名字，她又在下面签了一遍，末笔收得有些重。

pairs.target: wǎnghòu jiēhuó , ruò néng zhíjiē zài háng lǐ guàmíng , gōngqián biàn búbì zài cóng biérén shǒulǐ zhuǎn yìzāo .
pairs.english: For future jobs, if she could register directly with the guild, her wages wouldn't have to pass through anyone else's hands again.
pairs.hanzi: 往后接活，若能直接在行里挂名，工钱便不必再从别人手里转一遭。

pairs.target: tā duō kàn le nà xíng zì yíhuìer , děng mò gān le , cái bǎ zìjǐ de nà fèn zhé hǎo .
pairs.english: She studied that line of writing a little longer; once the ink was dry, only then did she fold her own copy away.
pairs.hanzi: 她多看了那行字一会儿，等墨干了，才把自己的那份折好。

pairs.target: chūménshí , tā xiàng pénglǐ wàng le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: On her way out, she glanced once into the shed.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，她向棚里望了一眼。

pairs.target: bèi jià kàoqiáng pái zhe , xīntiān de gānbù lùchū yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: The carrying frames stood in a row against the wall, a corner of the newly added dry cloth showing.
pairs.hanzi: 背架靠墙排着，新添的干布露出一角。

pairs.target: shào píngzhèng gēn rén zhēng yìgēn biǎndàn , shuí yě bùkěn rèn nà dào lièkǒu shì zìjǐ yāchūlái de .
pairs.english: Shao Ping was arguing with someone over a carrying pole; neither was willing to admit that the crack was from his own load.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平正跟人争一根扁担，谁也不肯认那道裂口是自己压出来的。

pairs.target: tā rěn zhe xiào , jiāng qìzhǐ chuāi jìn yījīn , wǎng jiā zǒu qù .
pairs.english: Holding back a smile, she tucked the contract inside her jacket and set off for home.
pairs.hanzi: 她忍着笑，将契纸揣进衣襟，往家走去。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn de lì jīn mǎn shì rèyóu hé héní de qìwèi .
pairs.english: Evening in Lijin was full of the smell of hot oil and river mud.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚的砾津满是热油和河泥的气味。

pairs.target: mǎtóu nàbiān gāng xièwán huò , kōngchē yà guò shí lù , lúnzǐ yí tiào , chēfū jiù mà yíjù .
pairs.english: At the docks they had just finished unloading; empty carts rattled over the stone road, and whenever a wheel jolted, a driver let out a curse.
pairs.hanzi: 码头那边刚卸完货，空车轧过石路，轮子一跳，车夫就骂一句。

pairs.target: lín zhào chuānguò chēduì , zài xiàngkǒu mǎi le yìxiǎobāo chǎo dòu , wǔ zài shǒulǐ , hái tàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao crossed through the carts and bought a small paper packet of roasted beans at the alley mouth, cupping it in her hands; it was still hot.
pairs.hanzi: 林照穿过车队，在巷口买了一小包炒豆，捂在手里，还烫。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn zuòzài ménbiān chāi jiùyī , jiǎo biān jī zhe yìquān suìbù .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou sat by the door unpicking old clothes, scraps of fabric gathering in a ring around her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶坐在门边拆旧衣，脚边积着一圈碎布。

pairs.target: wūlǐ méi diǎndēng , zuìhòu yìdiǎn tiānguāng zhèng luò zài tā de zhēnjiān shàng .
pairs.english: No lamp had been lit indoors; the last bit of daylight was falling on her needle tip.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里没点灯，最后一点天光正落在她的针尖上。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ dòuzǐ fàngdào tā xītóu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao placed the beans onto her lap.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把豆子放到她膝头。

pairs.target: " tiāo dà de mǎi de . "
pairs.english: “I picked out the big ones.”
pairs.hanzi: “挑大的买的。”

pairs.target: zhōu shěn niēqǐ yìkē , yǎo kāi , jiáo le liǎngxià .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou pinched up a bean, bit it open, and chewed twice.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶捏起一颗，咬开，嚼了两下。

pairs.target: " xián le . "
pairs.english: “Too salty.”
pairs.hanzi: “咸了。”

pairs.target: " nà gěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Give them to me, then.”
pairs.hanzi: “那给我。”

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu qù ná , zhōu shěn yǐjīng bǎ zhǐbāo nuó dào lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: She reached to take them, but Aunt Zhou had already moved the paper packet to her other side.
pairs.hanzi: 她伸手去拿，周婶已经把纸包挪到另一边。

pairs.target: " guō lǐ yǒu fàn , zìjǐ shèng . "
pairs.english: “There's rice in the pot; help yourself.”
pairs.hanzi: “锅里有饭，自己盛。”

pairs.target: fàn shàng wēn zhe bànwǎn dùn luóbo .
pairs.english: Half a bowl of stewed radish was keeping warm on top of the rice.
pairs.hanzi: 饭上温着半碗炖萝卜。

pairs.target: lín zhào duānchūlái , jiàng ménkǎn lǐ nà zhī xiǎo dèng tuō jìn , xīgài dǐ zhe wǎndǐ chī .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao carried it out, then drew closer the little stool just inside the threshold, and ate with her knees braced beneath the bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 林照端出来，将门槛里那只小凳拖近，膝盖抵着碗底吃。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn chāi xià yīxiù , bǎ hái wánhǎo de bù pù zài tuǐ shàng , yímiàn lǐ xiàn , yímiàn wèn tā míngzǎo jǐshí zǒu .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou detached a sleeve and spread the still-sound cloth over her legs, sorting thread while asking what time Lin Zhao would leave tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶拆下衣袖，把还完好的布铺在腿上，一面理线，一面问她明早几时走。

pairs.target: " mǎoshí dàohuò péng .
pairs.english: “At the freight shed by dawn.
pairs.hanzi: “卯时到货棚。

pairs.target: dōngxī dōu bèi hǎo le . "
pairs.english: All the things are ready now.”
pairs.hanzi: 东西都备好了。”

pairs.target: " shuǐnáng shì guò lòu méiyǒu ? "
pairs.english: “Have you checked the water skins for leaks?”
pairs.hanzi: “水囊试过漏没有？”

pairs.target: " shì guò . "
pairs.english: “I have.”
pairs.hanzi: “试过。”

pairs.target: " xié ne ? "
pairs.english: “And your shoes?”
pairs.hanzi: “鞋呢？”

pairs.target: lín zhào shēnchū jiǎo , ràng tā kàn xīn bǔ de xiédǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao stuck out a foot to show her the newly patched sole.
pairs.hanzi: 林照伸出脚，让她看新补的鞋底。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn dītóu niē le yíxià biānxiàn , méi tiāochū máobìng , biàn bǎ jiǎo tuīkāi .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou lowered her head, pinched the edge stitching once, and found no fault; then she nudged the foot away.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶低头捏了一下边线，没挑出毛病，便把脚推开。

pairs.target: " bié gē wǒ bù shàng . "
pairs.english: “Don't put it on my cloth.”
pairs.hanzi: “别搁我布上。”

pairs.target: lín zhào shōuhuí jiǎo , jiáqǐ yíkuài luóbo , hūrán shuō : " hòu jiē nà jiān fáng , hái kōng zhe . "
pairs.english: Lin Zhao withdrew her foot, picked up a piece of radish, and suddenly said, “That room on the back street remains empty.”
pairs.hanzi: 林照收回脚，夹起一块萝卜，忽然说：“后街那间房，还空着。”

pairs.target: zhōu shěn de zhēn tíng le tíng .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou's needle paused.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶的针停了停。

pairs.target: " kào rǎnfáng de ? "
pairs.english: “The one beside the dye works?”
pairs.hanzi: “靠染坊的？”

pairs.target: " zài guòqù yìjiān .
pairs.english: “One farther along.
pairs.hanzi: “再过去一间。

pairs.target: chuāng cháo dōng , shài dédào bèizi . "
pairs.english: The window faces east; the bedding can get some sun.”
pairs.hanzi: 窗朝东，晒得到被子。”

pairs.target: " nǐ yòu qù kàn le ? "
pairs.english: “You went to look again, did you?”
pairs.hanzi: “你又去看了？”

pairs.target: " lùguò . "
pairs.english: “I was passing.”
pairs.hanzi: “路过。”

pairs.target: zhōu shěn cóng zhǐbāo lǐ tiāo dòu , tiāo le bàntiān , tiāochū yìkē zuìxiǎo de .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou sorted through the beans in the paper packet for ages and finally picked out the smallest one.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶从纸包里挑豆，挑了半天，挑出一颗最小的。

pairs.target: " nà fángmén dī , nǐ bù xián pèngtóu ? "
pairs.english: “That doorway is low; don't you mind bumping your head?”
pairs.hanzi: “那房门低，你不嫌碰头？”

pairs.target: " wǒ yòu méi shào shū nàme gāo . "
pairs.english: “I'm hardly as tall as Uncle Shao.”
pairs.hanzi: “我又没邵叔那么高。”

pairs.target: " zūqián ne ? "
pairs.english: “What about the rent?”
pairs.hanzi: “租钱呢？”

pairs.target: lín zhào bào le shù , yòu bǎ wǎn wǎng xī shàng nuó wěn xiē .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao gave the figure, then shifted the bowl a little more securely onto her knees.
pairs.hanzi: 林照报了数，又把碗往膝上挪稳些。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí nádào chéngshì qián , néng xiānfù yíjì .
pairs.english: “With the completion bonus this time, we can pay for a season up front.
pairs.hanzi: “这回拿到成事钱，能先付一季。

pairs.target: děng yǒu le zìjǐ de xíng pái ——"
pairs.english: Once I have a porter license of my own—”
pairs.hanzi: 等有了自己的行牌——”

pairs.target: " xiān chīfàn . "
pairs.english: “Eat first.”
pairs.hanzi: “先吃饭。”

pairs.target: tā dīxiàtóu , bā le liǎngkǒu .
pairs.english: She lowered her head and took two mouthfuls.
pairs.hanzi: 她低下头，扒了两口。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn jìxù chāixiàn , guò le yíhuìer cái shuō : " zhù jìnqù hái dé tiāngè lúzǐ , nàbiān méi gōng zào . "
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou continued unpicking the stitching; after a while, she finally said, “We'll also have to add a stove when we move in; there's no communal kitchen there.”
pairs.hanzi: 周婶继续拆线，过了一会儿才说：“住进去还得添个炉子，那边没公灶。”

pairs.target: lín zhào táiqǐ liǎn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao lifted her face.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抬起脸。

pairs.target: " xiǎo de jiù gòu . "
pairs.english: “A small one will do.”
pairs.hanzi: “小的就够。”

pairs.target: tā shuō , " jiùhuòtān shàng yǒu . "
pairs.english: She said, “They have them at the secondhand stalls.”
pairs.hanzi: 她说，“旧货摊上有。”

pairs.target: " yāndào yě dé kàn .
pairs.english: “The flue needs checking too.
pairs.hanzi: “烟道也得看。

pairs.target: bié guāng kàn chuānghù . "
pairs.english: Don't just look at the windows.”
pairs.hanzi: 别光看窗户。”

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén jiù zhe nà wǎn luóbo , bǎ lúzǐ gāi fàng nǎér , dōngtiān de tàn wǎng nǎér duī , shāngliáng le hǎo yízhèn .
pairs.english: Over that bowl of radish, the pair spent quite a while discussing where to put the stove and where to stack charcoal for winter.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人就着那碗萝卜，把炉子该放哪儿、冬天的炭往哪儿堆，商量了好一阵。

pairs.target: shuō dào chuáng , yìjiàn yòu bùhé .
pairs.english: When they reached the subject of the bed, their opinions differed again.
pairs.hanzi: 说到床，意见又不合。

alignment.english: When they reached the subject of

pairs.target: lín zhào yào nuó dào chuāng biān , zhōu shěn shuō hé fēng wǎng gǔtou lǐ zuàn , zuìhòu shuí yě méi shuōfú shuí , fàn dǎo chī wán le .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao wanted to move it beside the window; Aunt Zhou said the river wind would bore into their bones; in the end neither convinced the other, though they did finish the meal.
pairs.hanzi: 林照要挪到窗边，周婶说河风往骨头里钻，最后谁也没说服谁，饭倒吃完了。

pairs.target: tiānhēi xiàlái , zhōu shěn shōu le zhēnxiàn , jìnwū diǎndēng .
pairs.english: As darkness fell, Aunt Zhou put away her sewing and went inside to light the lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 天黑下来，周婶收了针线，进屋点灯。

pairs.target: lín zhào duān zhe wǎn gēnjìnqù , kànjiàn zhuōshàng gēzhe yìzhī zhǎi cháng de yāodài , dié dé fāngzhèng , fèngkǒu dōu cáng zài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: Following her inside with the bowl, Lin Zhao saw a long, narrow waist pouch lying on the table, folded square, its seams all hidden inside.
pairs.hanzi: 林照端着碗跟进去，看见桌上搁着一只窄长的腰袋，叠得方正，缝口都藏在里面。

pairs.target: " yāo lǐ xì . "
pairs.english: “Tie it round your waist.”
pairs.hanzi: “腰里系。”

pairs.target: zhōu shěn bèiduìzhe tā shuō , " fàng diǎn gānliáng , gānjìng bù , bié shénme dōu wǎng dàbāo lǐ sāi . "
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou said with her back to her, “Put some dry food and clean cloth inside; don't stuff absolutely everything into the big pack.”
pairs.hanzi: 周婶背对着她说，“放点干粮、干净布，别什么都往大包里塞。”

pairs.target: lín zhào ná qǐlái , xì zài yāojiān shìleshì , chángduǎn zhènghǎo .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao picked it up and tried tying it round her waist; the length was just right.
pairs.hanzi: 林照拿起来，系在腰间试了试，长短正好。

pairs.target: tā wǎng lǐ zhuāng le liǎngkuài gān bǐng , shì zhe zuòxià , yòu zhàn qǐlái , juéde yìdiǎn yě bú àishì .
pairs.english: She put two pieces of flatbread inside, tried sitting down, then stood up again, and felt it did not hinder her whatsoever.
pairs.hanzi: 她往里装了两块干饼，试着坐下，又站起来，觉得一点也不碍事。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn zài dēng xià kàn tā zhēteng , zhōngyú rěnbúzhù xiào le .
pairs.english: In the lamplight, Aunt Zhou watched her fuss about, and finally couldn't hold back a laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶在灯下看她折腾，终于忍不住笑了。

pairs.target: " míngzǎo zài zhuāng , shuìjiào hái dài zhe ? "
pairs.english: “Pack it tomorrow morning; are you wearing it to bed too?”
pairs.hanzi: “明早再装，睡觉还带着？”

pairs.target: lín zhào jiě xià yāodài , jiāng tā fàngzài xié shàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao untied the pouch and placed it on her shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 林照解下腰袋，将它放在鞋上。

pairs.target: wūwài yǒurén dǎo xǐyī shuǐ , shuǐshēng guòhòu , nà rén yòu gé chuāng wèn zhōu shěn , míngrì yào buyào yídào qù kàn hòu jiē de fáng .
pairs.english: Someone outside poured away laundry water; after the splashing, that person asked Aunt Zhou through the window again whether she wanted to go along tomorrow to see the room on the back street.
pairs.hanzi: 屋外有人倒洗衣水，水声过后，那人又隔窗问周婶，明日要不要一道去看后街的房。

pairs.target: lín zhào qiǎng zhe yìng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao rushed to answer.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抢着应了一声。

pairs.target: " yào de .
pairs.english: “Yes, we do.
pairs.hanzi: “要的。

pairs.target: tì wǒmen kànkàn yāndào ! "
pairs.english: Check the flue for us!”
pairs.hanzi: 替我们看看烟道！”
